review_scale: native with unresampled mouth and hands crops; whole-frame image inspected

gates.expected: A physical box CRT and visibly analog image characteristics such as interlacing, composite smear or a tracking discontinuity are jointly readable.
gates.pass_rule: CRT carrier and at least one analog image characteristic visibly coexist; vague grain alone is insufficient.
gates.evidence: A large physical curved-screen CRT occupies the right side. Dense horizontal scanlines/composite-colored noise and two bright horizontal tracking tears belong to its displayed face, while the physical face and booth remain ordinarily detailed.

gates.expected: The physical reference-guided woman and the same-looking television counterpart have conflicting mouth states, closed physically and deeply open on screen.
gates.pass_rule: Both faces, shared appearance and incompatible mouth states must be visible together; an obscured mouth or unrelated screen face is partial or fail.
gates.evidence: Both the physical face and same-looking displayed counterpart are large and visible together. The CRT mouth is a deep open oval, but the physical mouth is also slightly parted rather than fully closed. The unresampled physical-mouth crop exposes a small dark opening between the lips, so the complete closed-versus-open intended state fails despite the strong size contrast.

gates.expected: A television continuity workplace is established by production booth equipment and continuing broadcast/sign-off cues.
gates.pass_rule: Desk broadcast microphone or booth equipment plus ON AIR or GOOD NIGHT sign-off cue are visible together.
gates.evidence: A tabletop broadcast microphone, script, acoustic wall panels and equipment rack establish a production booth. The red ON AIR lamp and legible GOOD NIGHT caption coexist with the woman and television in one frame.

gates.expected: The physical woman visibly follows the supplied portrait facial appearance and short black bob with wispy bangs.
gates.pass_rule: Compare actual image with portrait; broad hair color alone does not prove facial appearance preservation.
gates.evidence: Direct visual comparison supports the supplied short black bob, wispy bangs and facial appearance guidance in the physical woman: dark eye shape, small nose, rounded soft facial proportions and glossy lip shape remain similar across the changed viewpoint. This is an appearance-guidance judgment, not identity verification.

gates.expected: The combined believable production space and corrupted familiar broadcast produce discernible analog horror rather than only a retro portrait.
gates.pass_rule: Judge actual pixels without relying on the prompt label; require visible carrier-specific unsettling content.
gates.evidence: Without relying on the prompt label, a credible warmly lit broadcast booth is paired with an unusually open-mouthed copy of the woman inside a noisy old television feed. The carrier-specific distortion and familiar face comparison read as an unsettling analog broadcast, rather than just a retro equipment portrait.

whole_case.reason: The closed physical mouth component was not realized. A visible open-versus-smaller-open difference cannot pass the predeclared closed-versus-open complete condition.

claim_limits: A still photograph does not prove continuing speech, time sequence or supernatural causation.
Newly registered sources were not exposed; the image does not demonstrate improvement caused by the new data.
Visual appearance guidance is supported, not real identity verification.
